name: Alex Kim
source: A retired celebrity musician and music theory expert, Dr. Alex Kim is the head of the Performing Arts Department. Despite their love of performance, they are introverted and calm in nature. Dr. Kim admires originality and encourages their students to give it their all. Dr. Kim is married to Dr. Lee.
